company.name: GymNation
company.shortDescription: The Middle East’s largest low-cost gym operator
company.description:
GymNation is the Middle East’s largest low-cost gym operator, with close to 50 locations and over 200,000 members across the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, and Bahrain. Founded in Dubai in 2018, GymNation was built on a simple mission: to make world-class fitness affordable and accessible to everyone.

GymNation’s vision is to be The Region’s Movement Partner, championing active, healthy lifestyles and the connection between physical activity and mental wellbeing across the communities it serves.
